text:
Windows Image Viewer & Photo Manager is a fast, lightweight, free, and open-source desktop image viewer for Windows. Browse photos, navigate folders, edit images, organize files, and optionally play videos through a clean graphical interface without needing command-line knowledge.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Windows Image Viewer & Photo Manager 4.1.5.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Windows Image Viewer & Photo Manager 4.1.5.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Windows Image Viewer & Photo Manager 4.1.5.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

- ⚡ Fast Image Viewing — Open images quickly and browse large collections with responsive navigation and minimal interface distractions.
- 🔍 High Quality Image Scaling — Enjoy sharp image rendering with configurable scaling and zoom controls for different screen sizes.
- ✂️ Built-In Photo Editing — Crop, rotate, and resize pictures directly inside the Windows image viewer.
- 🗂️ Folder and Thumbnail Browser — Navigate image directories using convenient thumbnails and a dedicated folder browsing mode.
- 📁 Quick File Organization — Copy or move photos to frequently used destination folders with configurable keyboard shortcuts.
- 🎬 Optional Video Playback — Enable multimedia playback through the optional libmpv integration, including supported formats such as WebM.
- ⌨️ Customizable Keyboard Shortcuts — Configure controls, personalize the interface, and access common image management actions without navigating menus.
- 🖥️ Fullscreen and Slideshow — View images without distractions, launch slideshows, and explore collections in shuffle mode.
- 📷 Image Information — Inspect available image metadata and EXIF information through the built-in information panel.
- 🛠️ Custom Script Integration — Configure external commands and scripts to extend image workflows and automate repetitive tasks.

 🖼️ Overview

 

The application combines essential photo viewing and file management tools in one compact Windows desktop interface.

 Capability Description 
 --- --- 
 Image browsing Navigate between images in a directory 
 Zoom controls Inspect images at different magnifications 
 Folder navigation Browse directories and thumbnail collections 
 Image editing Crop, rotate, and resize pictures 
 File management Copy, move, and delete selected images 
 Multimedia Optional video playback integration 
 Personalization Configurable themes and keyboard controls 

 🚀 Usage

Getting started is straightforward:

1. Open an image — Select an image file or open a directory containing your photos.
2. Browse your collection — Use the arrow keys or mouse wheel to move between images.
3. Adjust the view — Zoom in, zoom out, or switch between window, width, and original-size viewing modes.
4. Organize pictures — Use the quick copy and move controls to transfer images between destination folders.
5. Edit images — Access the editing commands to crop, rotate, or resize your current picture.
6. Customize settings — Adjust keyboard shortcuts, themes, interface preferences, and optional integrations.

 ⌨️ Default Keyboard Shortcuts

The following table highlights common image viewer controls.

 Action Shortcut 
 --- --- 
 Next image Right Arrow / Mouse Wheel 
 Previous image Left Arrow / Mouse Wheel 
 First image Home 
 Last image End 
 Zoom in Ctrl + Up 
 Zoom out Ctrl + Down 
 Fit to window 1 
 Fit to width 2 
 Original size 3 
 Switch fit modes Space 
 Toggle fullscreen F / F11 
 Show image information I 
 Crop image X 
 Resize image R 
 Rotate left Ctrl + L 
 Rotate right Ctrl + R 
 Quick copy C 
 Quick move M 
 Move to trash Delete 
 Open folder view Enter / Backspace 
 Open file Ctrl + O 
 Save changes Ctrl + S 
 Open settings P 
 Start slideshow 
 Shuffle images Ctrl + 

 Tip: Keyboard bindings can be customized through the application settings.

 📂 Organize Images Faster

The quick copy and move panels make it easier to sort large photo collections.

- Configure frequently used destination folders.
- Open the copy or move panel.
- Select a destination using its corresponding number key.
- Transfer the currently displayed image without repeatedly browsing directories.

This workflow is useful for organizing screenshots, photographs, downloaded pictures, and other image collections.

 🎞️ Slideshow and Video Support

Use slideshow mode to browse a collection automatically or enable shuffle mode for randomized viewing.

For multimedia playback, the optional libmpv integration provides additional video capabilities when supported and configured in the application build.

 🖥️ Windows Desktop Experience

Designed for everyday desktop use, this image viewer keeps frequently needed tools accessible without overwhelming the viewing area.

Highlights include:

- A clean, uncluttered graphical interface.
- Convenient thumbnail and folder navigation.
- Configurable display and interaction settings.
- Fullscreen viewing for distraction-free browsing.
- Practical image organization and editing tools.
- Optional multimedia functionality.

Whether you need a lightweight photo viewer for everyday browsing or a practical utility for managing image folders, the application brings essential tools together in one place.

 🔒 Security & Privacy

Your files and privacy matter.

- No Telemetry: No built-in behavioral tracking or analytics collection is intended.
- No Account Required: Use the desktop application without creating an online account.
- Open Source: Inspect the source code and review how the application works.
- Local File Operations: Image browsing and editing are designed around files on your computer.
- Community Reporting: Report suspected security vulnerabilities or unexpected behavior through the repository's issue-tracking process.

Always keep backups of important photographs before performing destructive file
